name: set-permissions-forms-valid
description: setPermissions parses with the script's app and with an app id, and launchApp parses a permissions mapping.
yaml:
- setPermissions:
    permissions:
      camera: allow
      location: deny
- setPermissions:
    appId: dev.atomyx.demo
    permissions:
      notifications: allow
- launchApp:
    permissions:
      photos: allow
